evidence_requirements.internal: Locked grouped test data with no source, plant, burst, or duplicate leakage from training or calibration.
evidence_requirements.external: At least one source-locked independent field domain containing all three provisional labels and reported separately from internal test data.
evidence_requirements.acceptance: Per-class accepted-set confusion counts at the frozen refusal threshold; unfiltered closed-set precision is not a substitute.
evidence_requirements.ood: Both false-accept numerator and OOD denominator at the frozen operating point, judged by the upper 95% Wilson bound.
evidence_requirements.calibration: Temperature and refusal threshold fitted only on the locked calibration split, with test ECE reported after freezing.
evidence_requirements.device_and_int8: Hash-matched full-integer INT8 export, float-versus-INT8 parity, and physical Android warm/cold timing evidence.
evidence_requirements.nepal: The expected locked Nepal dataset must be independently labelled and explicitly pass before promotion can be reconsidered.

limitations: This is a standalone candidate-bundle policy; it does not modify or control tomato training.

Only early blight, late blight, and healthy are assessed as provisional known labels. Every other tomato symptom, disease, pest, deficiency, mixed condition, and unsuitable image remains open-set or refused.
Available public external tomato evidence is not assumed to meet the required per-class support or Nepal representativeness; missing evidence must fail closed rather than lower the gate.
Passing public internal, external, calibration, OOD, INT8, and device gates remains insufficient without locked independent Nepal field evidence.
promotion_allowed remains false until agronomy, localized safety, Nepal field, export/runtime, and rollout reviews explicitly supersede this policy.
